guard: a Claude Code or Desktop session Cotal did not launch joins only on cotal_connect, as an identity of its own on the mesh cotal spawn would pick, retires it on disconnect or exit, and in Claude Code is woken by the plugin's monitor once per unread message, never while a cotal_wait holds it, with no socket text reaching the model
command: pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/connector-core build && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/connector-claude-code build && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/cli build && pnpm exec tsx extensions/connector-claude-code/smoke/local-server-live.smoke.ts
why: The suite drives the built dist/mcp.cjs and dist/monitor.cjs and runs the built CLI, as Claude Code and cotal setup's record do, so each mutation rebuilds the package it changes before the run and after the restore.

The W cells were reproduced live in a real interactive Claude Code session on 2.1.295: an idle session woke from the monitor's event, read its inbox and replied by DM, and two plain sessions exchanged a question and an answer with no input.
W6 is the first design, which the twin-server cell found: a second server under one Claude Code process removed the first one's socket, so a monitor that started later heard nothing.

mutations.name: W1 a wake repeats before the read
mutations.expectRed: a second DM before the first is read adds no second wake
mutations.cell: a second DM before the first is read adds no second wake
mutations.command: pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/connector-core build && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/connector-claude-code build && pnpm exec tsx extensions/connector-claude-code/smoke/local-server-live.smoke.ts
mutations.note: One wake per unread batch, so a busy channel does not start a turn per message.

mutations.name: W2 a held cotal_wait is woken too
mutations.expectRed: a DM that a held cotal_wait returns wakes nothing
mutations.cell: a DM that a held cotal_wait returns wakes nothing
mutations.command: pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/connector-core build && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/connector-claude-code build && pnpm exec tsx extensions/connector-claude-code/smoke/local-server-live.smoke.ts
mutations.note: A message a held wait returns must not also start a second turn.

mutations.name: W3 cotal_inbox does not rearm the wake
mutations.expectRed: after the read, the next DM wakes the session again
mutations.cell: after the read, the next DM wakes the session again
mutations.command: pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/connector-core build && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/connector-claude-code build && pnpm exec tsx extensions/connector-claude-code/smoke/local-server-live.smoke.ts
mutations.note: After a read, the next message wakes the session again.

mutations.name: W4 an unheard wake counts as heard
mutations.expectRed: a monitor that starts after the message still gets its wake, as one fixed line
mutations.cell: a monitor that starts after the message still gets its wake, as one fixed line
mutations.command: pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/connector-core build && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/connector-claude-code build && pnpm exec tsx extensions/connector-claude-code/smoke/local-server-live.smoke.ts
mutations.note: A wake sent before any monitor reads is not lost.

mutations.name: W5 the server never rewakes when a monitor attaches
mutations.expectRed: a monitor that starts after the message still gets its wake, as one fixed line
mutations.cell: a monitor that starts after the message still gets its wake, as one fixed line
mutations.note: A monitor that starts late still hears what arrived before it.

mutations.name: W6 one shared socket per Claude Code process, as first written
mutations.expectRed: a monitor that starts after the message still gets its wake, as one fixed line
mutations.cell: a monitor that starts after the message still gets its wake, as one fixed line
mutations.note: The bug the smoke found: a second server under one Claude Code process removed the first one's socket.

mutations.name: W7 the monitor prints whatever the socket sends
mutations.expectRed: a monitor turns only a connection id into an event, and drops any other text
mutations.cell: a monitor turns only a connection id into an event, and drops any other text
mutations.note: No text from a socket reaches the model.

mutations.name: W8 the monitor runs in a launched session
mutations.expectRed: in a session Cotal launched, the monitor exits at once and prints nothing
mutations.cell: in a session Cotal launched, the monitor exits at once and prints nothing
mutations.note: A launched session has its own push.

mutations.name: W9 the monitor outlives its Claude Code process
mutations.expectRed: and exits once its Claude Code process is gone
mutations.cell: and exits once its Claude Code process is gone
mutations.note: A monitor whose session is gone must not linger.

mutations.name: W10 cotal_connect always says no monitor runs
mutations.expectRed: a conversation that connects while the monitor reads is told it will be woken
mutations.cell: a conversation that connects while the monitor reads is told it will be woken
mutations.note: cotal_connect tells the model whether it will be woken.

mutations.name: A1 cotal_disconnect does not retire
mutations.expectRed: and retires its credential directory, leaving the other one
mutations.cell: and retires its credential directory, leaving the other one
mutations.note: A disconnected conversation's identity is retired.

mutations.name: A2 the end of stdin does not end the server
mutations.expectRed: Desktop closing the server's stdin ends it cleanly
mutations.cell: Desktop closing the server's stdin ends it cleanly
mutations.note: Desktop ends a server by closing its stdin.

mutations.name: A3 Desktop reads its working directory
mutations.expectRed: a Desktop conversation started in that project joins the one running mesh
mutations.cell: a Desktop conversation started in that project joins the one running mesh
mutations.note: Desktop's working directory is not the person's project.

mutations.name: A4 provision counts a down mesh as running
mutations.expectRed: a Desktop conversation started in that project joins the one running mesh
mutations.cell: a Desktop conversation started in that project joins the one running mesh
mutations.note: Reproduced: with one mesh up and another recorded but down, provision was refused as ambiguous.
